name: insert and search single node
code:
t = AVLTree()
t.insert(10)
assert t.search(10) == True
assert t.search(5) == False

name: insert sorted sequence (tests balancing)
code:
t = AVLTree()
for i in range(1, 6):
    t.insert(i)
assert t.inorder() == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

name: insert reverse sorted sequence (tests balancing)
code:
t = AVLTree()
for i in range(5, 0, -1):
    t.insert(i)
assert t.inorder() == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

name: insert descending sequence
code:
t = AVLTree()
for i in range(10, -1, -1):
    t.insert(i)
assert t.inorder() == list(range(0, 11))

name: search after insertion
code:
t = AVLTree()
t.insert(15)
t.insert(10)
t.insert(20)
assert t.search(10) == True
assert t.search(15) == True
assert t.search(20) == True
assert t.search(25) == False

name: insert duplicates kept as tree (no duplicates)
code:
t = AVLTree()
t.insert(10)
t.insert(10)
t.insert(10)
assert t.inorder() == [10]

name: alternating insert order
code:
t = AVLTree()
for i in [3, 2, 4, 1, 5]:
    t.insert(i)
assert t.inorder() == [1, 2, 3, 4, 5]

name: empty tree search and inorder
code:
t = AVLTree()
assert t.search(1) == False
assert t.inorder() == []

name: large insertion order preserves balance
code:
t = AVLTree()
n = 20
data = [5, 3, 7, 1, 4, 6, 8, 2, 9, 0, 10, 12, 11, 14, 13, 15, 17, 16, 18, 19]
for x in data:
    t.insert(x)
assert t.inorder() == list(range(n))
